_comment: Optional details per photo, keyed by 'folder/file-name.jpg'. Everything is optional: without an entry a photo still appears, captioned from its file name. Fields: caption, alt, location, tags (extra filters, e.g. ["before-after"]), featured (true = shown first), date (YYYY-MM-DD, newer first).
